<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex23012023-09-18-102" status="finalized" ana="corpusmd:colophon">
               <l><rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5657">gtsang dge'i 'byung
                  gnas pa tshab <choice><orig>sgon</orig><reg>dgon</reg></choice> pa</rs> ru || </l>
                  <l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3918">shes rab <choice><reg>mtha'</reg><orig>mtha</orig></choice> can dge sbyong bdag</rs> gis bsdus || 
                  </l>
                  <l>de zer ma 'brel stong phrag rmig rjes chu ||</l> 
                  <l><lb edRef="inst:4638" n="188b7"/> khyad par gsum ldan legs rgya mtsho bzhin ||</l> 
                  <l>zhe sdang phrag dog khengs pa kun spongs la ||</l> 
                  <l>tshul bzhin seMs pa'i yid kyis dpyad par gyis ||</l> 
                  <l>ma rtogs rang dga' <choice><reg>ba'i</reg><orig>'i</orig></choice> 'dod pas nyes bshad rnaMs ||</l> 
                  <l>yang dag thugs su chud rnaMs bzod pa mdzod ||</l> 
                  <l>de stem<note type="editorial">Reads like "sdim"</note> la 'byung dge ba gang thob<note type="editorial">Reading of 'thob' uncertain</note> des ||</l>  
                  <l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3918">bdag sogs</rs> 'gro mgon sa thob gyi bar |</l> </seg></TEI>
